name: Baseline Human
description: Unmodified or lightly modified humans descended from Earth-origin populations.

name: Adapted Human
description: Human populations with inherited or engineered adaptations for specific environments, gravity ranges or long-duration space habitation.

name: Velari
description: A sapient non-human species integrated into parts of Reach commerce and science. Velari physiology is tall, fine-boned and adapted to lower gravity.

name: Thalen
description: A compact, high-gravity-adapted sapient species encountered through trade networks beyond the Reach and now present in small permanent communities.

name: Synthetic Mind
description: Persistent self-aware machine intelligences recognised as persons in several Reach jurisdictions.
